Gong Cha Menu: Everything You Need to Know About Toppings

When it comes to enjoying a delicious bubble tea experience at Gong Cha, one of the most exciting aspects is customizing your drink with a variety of toppings. From chewy boba to rich and creamy milk foam, the toppings at Gong Cha USA elevate each drink, allowing you to craft a beverage that perfectly matches your taste.

In this comprehensive guide, we’ll take you through everything you need to know about the toppings available on the Gong Cha menu. Whether you’re a boba tea newbie or a seasoned bubble tea fan, you’ll find valuable insights on how to make the most of the tea offerings by choosing the right toppings, customizing your order, and even finding the best deals. By the end of this article, you’ll know all the ins and outs of building the perfect Gong Cha drink.

What Are the Best Toppings at Gong Cha?

The toppings at Gong Cha add texture, flavor, and fun to your bubble tea. Whether you prefer chewy, creamy, or jelly-like textures, there’s something for everyone. Here are the most popular toppings that can be added to any Gong Cha drink.

Boba (Tapioca Pearls)

Arguably the most iconic topping in the bubble tea world, boba or tapioca pearls are chewy, round balls made from tapioca starch. They provide a delightful texture contrast to the smoothness of milk tea or fruit tea.

Topping Add-On Price
Boba (Tapioca Pearls) $0.50

Milk Foam

Milk foam is a creamy, slightly sweet layer that is added to the top of the drink. It creates a rich contrast to the tea and pairs particularly well with milk tea or brewed tea.

Topping Add-On Price
Milk Foam $0.75

Aloe Vera

For a lighter, refreshing texture, aloe vera is a great choice. It’s a healthier alternative to traditional toppings and pairs well with fruity flavors like mango or lychee.

Topping Add-On Price
Aloe Vera $0.50

Herbal Jelly

Herbal jelly has a subtle, slightly bitter flavor that complements the sweetness of bubble tea. This is a popular topping for those who enjoy an earthy flavor profile in their drink.

Topping Add-On Price
Herbal Jelly $0.50

Pudding

Pudding is a sweet, custard-like topping that adds richness to any Gong Cha drink. It’s soft and creamy, making it a delightful addition to milk tea series drinks or coffee series options.

Topping Add-On Price
Pudding $0.75

Lychee Jelly

If you love fruity and slightly chewy toppings, lychee jelly is a must-try. Its sweet and floral flavor pairs perfectly with any fruit tea or classic tea flavors like oolong or green tea.

Topping Add-On Price
Lychee Jelly $0.50

Customizing Your Gong Cha Drink with Toppings

One of the key features of the Gong Cha USA experience is the ability to fully customize your drink. You can choose your tea base, sweetness level, ice level, and of course, your toppings. Whether you prefer classic boba tea or you want to experiment with milk foam series drinks, the options are endless.

Adjusting Sweetness Levels

At Gong Cha, you can control how sweet your bubble tea is. This customization allows you to match your drink to your taste preferences.

Sweetness Level Description
100% Standard sweetness
70% Slightly reduced sweetness
50% Balanced sweetness
30% Mild sweetness
0% No added sweetness

Choosing Your Ice Level

For those who prefer a cooler drink or want to keep their bubble tea at room temperature, you can customize the ice level in your Gong Cha order.

Ice Level Description
Regular Ice Standard amount of ice
Less Ice Reduced amount of ice
No Ice No ice

Seasonal Toppings and Specials at Gong Cha

Gong Cha USA often introduces seasonal toppings and new menu items that reflect the flavors of the season. These limited-time toppings bring fresh, exciting tastes to your favorite Gong Cha drinks. Let’s explore some of the seasonal specials and topping options that have been featured in the past.

Winter Special – Brown Sugar Boba

During the colder months, Gong Cha often introduces brown sugar boba as a special topping. This tapioca pearl topping is cooked in rich brown sugar syrup, adding a deep caramel flavor to your drink.

Topping Add-On Price
Brown Sugar Boba $0.75

Summer Special – Coconut Jelly

For a tropical twist during the summer, coconut jelly is a refreshing option that pairs perfectly with fruit teas like mango or passionfruit.

Topping Add-On Price
Coconut Jelly $0.75

Milk Foam Series – A Creamy Addition

The milk foam series at Gong Cha offers drinks topped with a rich, velvety layer of milk foam. This topping is especially popular in brewed tea and milk tea drinks, adding a luxurious and indulgent texture.

What Is Milk Foam?

Milk foam is a whipped, creamy topping that adds richness to your Gong Cha drink. It’s slightly sweet, which creates a delightful contrast when paired with the more bitter flavors of green tea or oolong tea.

Popular Milk Foam Series Drinks

Here are some customer favorites from the milk foam series.

Drink Medium Price Large Price
Green Tea with Milk Foam $5.25 $6.25
Oolong Tea with Milk Foam $5.25 $6.25
Earl Grey Tea with Milk Foam $5.50 $6.50

The milk foam series offers a creamy and smooth experience that’s perfect for tea lovers who want a bit of indulgence in their cup.

Toppings for Coffee Lovers

In addition to tea, Gong Cha also offers a coffee series, and you can enhance your coffee drinks with various toppings. Whether you’re enjoying a creamy latte or an iced coffee, these toppings will add a fun twist.

Toppings for Coffee Series Drinks

Here are some of the best topping options for Gong Cha coffee series drinks:

  • Pudding: Adds a creamy, custard-like texture to iced coffee drinks.
  • Boba: Chewy tapioca pearls provide a fun contrast to cold coffee beverages.
  • Milk Foam: A layer of milk foam adds richness to both iced coffee and espresso drinks.

Gong Cha’s Commitment to Quality

Every Gong Cha drink is crafted with a commitment to quality and freshness. The toppings, just like the tea and other ingredients, are of premium quality to ensure a satisfying experience with every sip.

Freshly Made Toppings

All of Gong Cha’s toppings are prepared fresh daily to ensure the best texture and flavor. Whether it’s the chewy boba, soft pudding, or smooth milk foam, each topping is made with care to provide you with the freshest, most delicious experience.

Gong Cha Menu: Top Combinations with Toppings

Now that you know all about the toppings at Gong Cha, let’s look at some of the best drink combinations you can try. Each combination pairs the perfect toppings with the right base drink for an elevated tea experience.

Classic Pearl Milk Tea with Boba

The ultimate bubble tea experience, the Classic Pearl Milk Tea is made even better with the addition of boba. The chewy tapioca pearls complement the creamy milk tea, creating a balanced, delicious drink.

Mango Green Tea with Aloe Vera

For a lighter, refreshing option, try the Mango Green Tea with aloe vera. The aloe adds a crisp texture that pairs well with the fruity mango flavor.

Oolong Tea with Milk Foam and Pudding

If you love rich flavors, the combination of Oolong Tea with milk foam and pudding is a must-try. The slightly bitter oolong tea is balanced by the creamy toppings, creating a decadent treat.

Drink Medium Price Large Price
Oolong Tea with Milk Foam $5.25 $6.25
Add Pudding +$0.75

Ordering Gong Cha Online

If you’re craving bubble tea but don’t have time to visit a store, you can easily order your favorite Gong Cha drinks online. Gong Cha USA has an easy-to-use online ordering system, allowing you to customize your drink, add your preferred toppings, and enjoy Gong Cha at home.

With so many options to choose from, the world of Gong Cha toppings can be a bit overwhelming, but also incredibly fun. Whether you’re a fan of chewy boba, creamy milk foam, or refreshing aloe vera, there’s a topping combination for everyone.
